response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development and architecture across various domains, but his background lacks direct exposure to hardware optimization, SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architectures, or deep-learning workload optimization—core requirements for the Principal Performance Architect role. His expertise in web, mobile, and embedded systems is strong, but not aligned with the specialized hardware/cloud infrastructure focus of this position.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with experience in performance optimization and system architecture design
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical leadership (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Familiarity with low-latency systems and high-performance databases (e.g., DLang, MongoDB)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling or AI accelerator hardware optimization
Lacks direct experience with deep-learning workload training/inference optimization or GPU architecture
Background does not align with the required hardware-software co-design or AI accelerator trade-off analysis
